simulation_id.title: Simulation ID
simulation_id.description: This field contains the simulation identifier if the advancement is not confirmed yet.

advancement_request_id.title: Advancement request ID
advancement_request_id.description: This field identifies the advancement request if it is confirmed by the user.

type.title: Type
type.description: This field identifies the type of advancement transaction.

begin_date.title: Begin date
begin_date.description: This field identifies the start date of the period used for searching for advanceable transactions.

end_date.title: End date
end_date.description: This field identifies the end date of the period used for searching for advanceable transactions.

request_date.title: Request date
request_date.description: This field identifies the date when the advancement was requested.

advancement_fee.title: Advancement fee
advancement_fee.description: This field contains the amount of fee payed for the advancement.

campaign_advancement_fee.title: Advancement fee
campaign_advancement_fee.description: This field contains the amount of fee payed for the advancement if using specific campaign.

advanced_gross_amount.title: Advanced gross amount
advanced_gross_amount.description: This field identifies the gross amount advanced.

advanced_net_amount.title: Advanced net amount
advanced_net_amount.description: This field identifies the net amount advanced.

advanced_discount_amount.title: Advanced discount amount
advanced_discount_amount.description: This field identifies the discount amount for the advancement.

interest_method.title: Interest method
interest_method.description: This field identifies the interest method used for this advancement request.

status.title: Status
status.description: This field identifies the current status of the advancement request.

error_message.title: Error message
error_message.description: This field identifies the error if something goes wrong during the advancement process.

merchant_id.title: Merchant ID
merchant_id.description: This field identifies one merchant related to advancement request.

merchant_name.title: Merchant name
merchant_name.description: This field identifies the name of the merchant.

advanced_gross_amount.title: Advanced gross amount
advanced_gross_amount.description: This field identifies the gross amount advanced from this merchant.

advanced_net_amount.title: Advanced net amount
advanced_net_amount.description: This field identifies the net amount advanced from this merchant.

advanced_discount_amount.title: Advanced discount amount
advanced_discount_amount.description: This field identifies the discounted amount for this merchant in this advancement.

discount_rate.title: Discount rate
discount_rate.description: This field identifies the discount rate of this merchant in advancements.

campaign_discount_rate.title: Campaign discount rate
campaign_discount_rate.description: This field identifies the discount rate for a specific campaign.

maximum_advancement_percentage.title: Maximum advancement percentage
maximum_advancement_percentage.description: This field identifies the discounted rate of this merchant in advancements.

transactions_ids.title: Transactions IDs
transactions_ids.description: This field contains a list of transactions of this merchant used in this advancement.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Customer-provided information - no business rule validation is done.
